title: FH Volvo Series 3 FUPS Powder Coated Bullbar #19
description: Volvo FH Series 3 Hi-tensile Powder Coated Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts and indicator repeaters mounted in external box uprights can be fitted on request. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin which is easy to access without removing signs.
